resources.name: Open-source DFT package (Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, or equivalent)

access.notes: Any DFT code supporting GGA-PBE with D3 dispersion and NEB is acceptable. The agent must use an open-source alternative to VASP.

resources.name: Crystal structures of M3C2 MXenes (V3C2, Nb3C2)

access.notes: Bulk structures can be derived from published MAX phase lattice parameters (e.g., V3AlC2, Nb3AlC2) by removing Al layers and constructing slabs; the geometry is well known in the literature.
Standard molecular geometries; can be optimized independently or taken from standard computational chemistry databases.
